SELECT c.id, COALESCE(SUM(touch.weight * POW(#{model.decayBase}, -touch.age_days / #{model.halfLifeDays})), 0.0) AS raw_weight, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN touch.age_days <= #{model.recentWindowDays} THEN touch.weight ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0) AS recent_weight, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN touch.age_days > #{model.recentWindowDays} AND touch.age_days <= #{model.priorWindowDays} THEN touch.weight ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0) AS prior_weight, DATE_FORMAT(MAX(touch.touched_at), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS last_touch_at, SUM(CASE WHEN touch.age_days <= #{model.recentWindowDays} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_touch_count FROM company c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT attributed.company_id, attributed.touched_at, attributed.weight, GREATEST(0.0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, attributed.touched_at, #{reference}) / #{model.microsecondsPerDay}) AS age_days FROM ( SELECT source.source_type, source.source_id, source.company_id, source.interaction_type, source.touched_at, source.weight FROM (
) source WHERE source.touched_at IS NOT NULL AND source.touched_at <= #{reference} GROUP BY source.source_type, source.source_id, source.company_id, source.interaction_type, source.touched_at, source.weight ) attributed ) touch ON touch.company_id = c.id WHERE GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY c.id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS contributor_count, COALESCE(SUM(capped.base_weight * POW(#{model.decayBase}, -capped.age_days / #{model.halfLifeDays})), 0.0) AS total_decayed_contribution, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN capped.source_type = 'activity' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS activity_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN capped.source_type = 'note' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS note_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN capped.source_type = 'task' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS task_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN capped.age_days <= #{model.recentWindowDays} THEN capped.base_weight ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0) AS recent_weight, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN capped.age_days > #{model.recentWindowDays} AND capped.age_days <= #{model.priorWindowDays} THEN capped.base_weight ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0) AS prior_weight, DATE_FORMAT(MAX(capped.touched_at), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS last_touch_at, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN capped.age_days <= #{model.recentWindowDays} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS recent_touch_count FROM ( SELECT source.source_type, source.touched_at, source.weight AS base_weight, GREATEST(0.0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, source.touched_at, #{reference}) / #{model.microsecondsPerDay}) AS age_days
) capped

SELECT aged.source_type, aged.source_id, aged.interaction_type, DATE_FORMAT(aged.touched_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS occurred_at, aged.base_weight, aged.base_weight * POW(#{model.decayBase}, -aged.age_days / #{model.halfLifeDays}) AS decayed_contribution, provider_activity.provider_name, provider_activity.provider_stream, provider_activity.provider_source_id, DATE_FORMAT(provider_activity.provider_captured_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS provider_captured_at, CASE WHEN provider_activity.provider_owned THEN DATE_FORMAT(#{reference}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') END AS capture_as_of, provider_activity.provider_visibility, provider_activity.provider_admitted_fields_json, provider_activity.provider_material_exclusions_json FROM ( SELECT source.source_type, source.source_id, source.interaction_type, source.touched_at, source.weight AS base_weight, GREATEST(0.0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, source.touched_at, #{reference}) / #{model.microsecondsPerDay}) AS age_days
) aged LEFT JOIN activity provider_activity ON aged.source_type = 'activity' AND provider_activity.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND provider_activity.id = aged.source_id ORDER BY decayed_contribution DESC, aged.touched_at DESC, aged.source_type, aged.source_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM person p WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.company_id = #{companyId} AND p.archived_at IS NULL) AS person_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM deal d WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.company_id = #{companyId}) AS num_deals, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity a WHERE a.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM person p WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.id = a.person_id AND p.company_id = #{companyId} AND p.archived_at IS NULL) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deal d WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.id = a.deal_id AND d.company_id = #{companyId}))) AS num_activities, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM person p WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.id = t.person_id AND p.company_id = #{companyId} AND p.archived_at IS NULL) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deal d WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.id = t.deal_id AND d.company_id = #{companyId}))) AS num_tasks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.completed = FALSE AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM person p WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.id = t.person_id AND p.company_id = #{companyId} AND p.archived_at IS NULL) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deal d WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.id = t.deal_id AND d.company_id = #{companyId}))) AS open_tasks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM note n WHERE n.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND n.visibility = 'workspace' AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM person p WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.id = n.person_id AND p.company_id = #{companyId} AND p.archived_at IS NULL) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deal d WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.id = n.deal_id AND d.company_id = #{companyId}))) AS num_notes

SELECT related.user_id, COUNT(*) OVER() AS total_users FROM ( SELECT touch.user_id, MAX(touch.touched_at) AS last_touched_at FROM ( SELECT a.created_by_id AS user_id, a.timestamp AS touched_at FROM activity a WHERE a.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM person p WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.id = a.person_id AND p.company_id = #{companyId} AND p.archived_at IS NULL) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deal d WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.id = a.deal_id AND d.company_id = #{companyId})) UNION ALL SELECT t.assigned_to_id AS user_id, t.created_at AS touched_at FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM person p WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.id = t.person_id AND p.company_id = #{companyId} AND p.archived_at IS NULL) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deal d WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.id = t.deal_id AND d.company_id = #{companyId})) UNION ALL SELECT n.author_id AS user_id, n.created_at AS touched_at FROM note n WHERE n.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND n.visibility = 'workspace' AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM person p WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.id = n.person_id AND p.company_id = #{companyId} AND p.archived_at IS NULL) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deal d WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.id = n.deal_id AND d.company_id = #{companyId})) ) touch WHERE touch.user_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY touch.user_id ) related ORDER BY related.last_touched_at DESC, related.user_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT FLOOR(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, #{windowStart}, touch.touched_at) / 604800) AS bucket_index, SUM(touch.kind = 'activities') AS activities, SUM(touch.kind = 'tasks') AS tasks, SUM(touch.kind = 'notes') AS notes FROM ( SELECT 'activities' AS kind, a.timestamp AS touched_at FROM activity a WHERE a.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND a.timestamp >= #{windowStart} AND a.timestamp <= #{windowEnd} AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM person p WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.id = a.person_id AND p.company_id = #{companyId} AND p.archived_at IS NULL) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deal d WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.id = a.deal_id AND d.company_id = #{companyId})) UNION ALL SELECT 'tasks' AS kind, t.created_at AS touched_at FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.created_at >= #{windowStart} AND t.created_at <= #{windowEnd} AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM person p WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.id = t.person_id AND p.company_id = #{companyId} AND p.archived_at IS NULL) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deal d WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.id = t.deal_id AND d.company_id = #{companyId})) UNION ALL SELECT 'notes' AS kind, n.created_at AS touched_at FROM note n WHERE n.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND n.visibility = 'workspace' AND n.created_at >= #{windowStart} AND n.created_at <= #{windowEnd} AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM person p WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.id = n.person_id AND p.company_id = #{companyId} AND p.archived_at IS NULL) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deal d WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.id = n.deal_id AND d.company_id = #{companyId})) ) touch GROUP BY bucket_index ORDER BY bucket_index

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(d.currency, ''), 'USD') AS currency, COUNT(*) AS deal_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.won = TRUE THEN d.actual_value ELSE 0 END), 0) AS past_revenue, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.won IS NULL THEN d.value ELSE 0 END), 0) AS projected_revenue FROM deal d WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.company_id = #{companyId} GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(d.currency, ''), 'USD') ORDER BY deal_count DESC, currency
